title: Selling Plans Early Termination Fees — Net Fee Volume Relief
content:
A **Selling Plans** store that has billed high net seller fees over the last year receives a volume relief on the early termination fee charged when its annual term is ended early.

**Clause.** The volume relief of an early termination fee is the high termination volume relief when the plan's net seller fees over the last twelve whole months are at least the high termination net-fee threshold, the mid termination volume relief when they are at least the mid termination net-fee threshold but below the high one, and nothing otherwise; net seller fees are the subscription, insertion, final value and early termination fees billed less the fee credits booked, each counted when its billing date is less than twelve whole months before the decision date.

A relief is taken from the plan's early termination fee share: the reliefs that apply are added together first and the total is taken from the share once.

## Schedule

| Net seller fees, last twelve whole months | Volume relief taken from the share |
|---|---|
| USD 12000.00 or more (the high termination net-fee threshold) | 15 percentage points |
| USD 6000.00 or more but below USD 12000.00 | 10 percentage points |
| Below USD 6000.00 | None |

Net seller fees add the subscription, insertion, final value and early termination fees billed and subtract the fee credits booked, whatever their credit reason; each record counts when its billing date is less than twelve whole months before the decision date.

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical totals)

- Net USD 12000.00 → 15 points; net USD 11999.99 → 10 points.
- Net USD 6000.00 → 10 points; net USD 5999.99 → no volume relief.

**Taken from the share (hypothetical).** On a plan whose early termination fee share is 50%, a volume relief of 10 points alone leaves a share of 40%.
